effect.name: Vignette
effect.description: Darkens the edges so the eye goes to the middle. Subtle at 0.3, a torch-lit cave at 0.9.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Edge Colour
parameter.description: What the edges fade toward. Black is the usual answer; the DMG darkest green keeps it on palette.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: How far from the centre the darkening starts.

parameter.name: Roundness
parameter.description: 1 is a circle, 0 follows the shape of the object so a wide screen gets a wide vignette.
